title: Snowy Hub | Silent Aim, Fling All, Auto Destroy & More
features:
Fling Toggle – Enables fling behavior for grabbed objects or players.

Fling Strength – Adjusts the force applied when flinging.

Silent Aim – Assists with targeting grab points within a configurable radius.

Fling Selected Player – Targets and flings a selected player.

Fling All Players – Repeatedly attempts to fling other players.

Fling Touch – Automatically activates a fling effect when players approach.

Teleport & Fling – Teleports near a selected player and performs a fling.

Server Fling All – Processes eligible players one by one.

Anti-Grab – Helps prevent your character from being grabbed or dragged.

Self Defense – Automatically responds to detected grab attempts.

Anti-Kick Grab – Attempts to counter kick-grab interactions.

Anti-Explosive – Helps protect against explosive interactions.

NoClip – Allows movement through normally collidable objects.

Infinite Jump – Enables repeated jumping.

Further Reach – Extends interaction or grab reach.

Movement Speed – Adjusts custom movement speed.

Jump Power – Adjusts custom jump strength.

Fly – Enables flight movement.

Fly Speed – Adjusts flight speed.

Invisibility – Attempts to hide your character.

Force Third Person – Switches the camera to third-person view.

NoClip Grab – Enables a special grab mode with collision bypass behavior.

Poison Grab – Applies a poison-themed grab effect.

Radioactive Grab – Applies a radioactive-themed grab effect.

Ignite Grab – Applies an ignition effect while grabbing.

Aura Radius – Adjusts the range of aura effects.

Air Suspend Aura – Suspends nearby targets in the air.

Poison Aura – Applies a poison effect to nearby targets.

Destroy Server Speed – Adjusts the Blobman server-destruction routine speed.

Destroy All – Performs a mass Blobman action.

HitBox Expander – Enlarges target hitboxes.

Ragdoll All Players – Applies ragdoll effects to other players.

Ignite All Players – Applies ignition effects to eligible players.

Kick All Players – Attempts to remove other players.

Tornado Orbit – Orbits targets around your character.

Teleport to Mouse – Teleports toward the mouse position.

Kill Target Under Cursor – Targets the player under your cursor.

Burn Target Under Cursor – Uses the Campfire toy on the targeted player.

Spawn Bomb Missile – Spawns a BombMissile toy.

Panic / Stop All – Disables active automation loops.

Unload SnowyHub – Completely unloads the hub and its active routines.
